name: Protopasta Magnetic Iron PLA @base
filament_notes:
Proto-Pasta data: 200C@24 mm3/s, 55C plate; FAQ: prints ~10C cooler than standard PLA (185-195C). Avoid printing below 3 mm3/s.
If warping occurs, reduce fan speed or print slower (table cap 24 mm3/s is a maximum, not a target). Ferromagnetic but not a magnet itself; rustable for aged finishes. Brittle in spool form; ~100 m per 500 g.
